## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `e167808a8aa8a52b7e9f37bb6e43b5f64a8e16dd`
Local-runs: none

Inputs: card #12146 (body and all four comments: triage `6110813809`, deferral `6111301923`, claim `6115255402`, os-dev-report `6115560272`), PR #12167 (body, 16-file list, net diff against `main` at the head), the head's check-runs, plus head-pinned reads of the files the diff touches or calls (`versionPrecedence.ts`, `packages/i18n/src/index.ts`, `.changeset/config.json`, `packages/app-shell/src/index.ts`, the components `dialog.tsx`, the CI workflow files). Nothing built, run or re-run.

### ① Derived judgments

1. **`@object-ui/i18n` accept set widens — RIGHT.** Eight leaf keys land in all ten packs at one path: `marketplace.update.dialogTitle`, `dialogDescCurrent`, `dialogDescPicker`, `majorNotice`, `releaseNotes`, `success`, `deployTimeout`, and `marketplace.action.updating`. Compared hunk by hunk across the ten packs: same keys, same placeholder set per key (name; host; none; fromMajor and toMajor; version; version; version; none). `TranslationKeys` is `typeof en` and is exported from `packages/i18n/src/index.ts`, so the published key union widens. Nothing is removed or renamed, and no existing `en` value moves (the `i18n-drift` reading of 0 changed values is consistent with the diff). This is the one accept-set change the diff implies, and it is additive.
2. **`@object-ui/app-shell` public surface does not move — RIGHT.** `MarketplacePackagePage` is exported from the package index; it takes no props and gains none. `MarkdownText` is not exported from the index. `Block.type` gaining `html`, `DeployState` gaining `updatedTo`, `DialogUpdate`, `majorOf` and `versionEntryId` are module-internal. The new DOM `id` and `tabIndex` on each Versions entry and the two `data-testid`s are not an accept set. The changeset's sentence "No export, prop or accept set moves" is true of app-shell.
3. **Install request shape unchanged; the update sends `seedSampleData: false` — RIGHT.** `installPackage` keeps its three fields; the update path sends what an unticked checkbox sends, the install path sends the checkbox's value (held by the CONTROL pin). This satisfies the triage ruling on both of its branches (seed into live data: hide; no-op: hide), so the unmeasured cloud half (H2) cannot change the outcome.
4. **Update mode fixed at open — RIGHT.** `openInstall(update)` has exactly one caller, the primary action's `onClick`, which passes `from: cloudInstalledVersion, to: latestVersion` only when `cloudUpdateAvailable`, else `null`. No bare `onClick={openInstall}` remains at the head, so no event object can land in `dialogUpdate`. The mode therefore survives the success path flipping `cloudInstalledVersion`.
5. **`majorOf` is safe by construction — RIGHT.** Update mode requires `isNewerVersion(latest, installed)`, whose parser accepts strict SemVer 2.0.0 only (a leading `v` is refused, the `installed` sentinel has no precedence), so both versions carry a numeric first identifier whenever `majorOf` runs.
6. **Major notice and link — RIGHT.** Drawn only when the target's major exceeds the from's; the link only when `data.versions` holds the target with non-blank `release_notes`; following it stores a one-shot ref, closes the dialog, and Radix's `onCloseAutoFocus` (the components `DialogContent` forwards `ComponentPropsWithoutRef` of the primitive, so the prop types) moves focus and scroll to that entry instead of the opener. Matches the card's "one line saying so, linking to the version's release notes".
7. **Wording against the card — RIGHT.** zh: title 「更新 NAME」, button `marketplace.action.updateTo` = 「更新」 (a bare word in zh and en, key unchanged), running 「更新中…」, result 「已更新到 vX。」, the versions line through `marketplace.versionBadge` (vX → vY). The card wrote the versions and the result without the `v`; the `v` follows the page's own badge spelling. A copy nuance, not a defect.
8. **Result sentences on every path — RIGHT.** Other environment: `update.success`; served: `update.success`; wait expired: `update.deployTimeout`; "Check again" carries `updatedTo` through. The install path keeps `install.success`, `install.deployed`, `install.deployTimeout`.
9. **Checkbox hidden in both dialog branches — RIGHT** (default environment, and the environment picker).
10. **`MarkdownText` raw HTML — RIGHT.** Block grammar: the seven start conditions of the CommonMark "HTML blocks" section with their end conditions, the condition-6 tag list current (`search` included); the start line is itself tested against the end condition, so a one-line comment or paragraph-tag block closes on its own line; the fenced-code check runs first, so HTML inside a fence stays code; conditions 1–6 interrupt a paragraph and 7 does not, as the spec says. Inline: open tag, closing tag, comment (both short forms included), processing instruction, declaration, CDATA, per the "Raw HTML" section; the tokenizer takes the earliest match, so a code span that begins before a tag wins. On the card's README the centred-paragraph block is condition 6 and runs to the blank line: neither the tags nor the relative icon path is printed, and the heading after it renders. An angle-bracketed URL is not a tag by the grammar (the colon breaks the tag name) and the renderer never drew autolinks, so it stays text as before: no regression.
    One nit, not a defect: condition 7's negative lookahead excludes the closing tags of pre, script, style and textarea as well, where the spec excludes only their open tags. A lone closing tag of one of those on its own line falls to the paragraph path and the inline pass drops it, leaving an empty paragraph. Cosmetic; nothing in evidence has it.
11. **"No ad-hoc regex" — RIGHT as read.** The regexes are the spec's productions, placed in the parser as a block or inline node the renderer skips; the source is never pre-filtered. The ruling's referent, "the renderer's own option", has no object: `MarkdownText` imports only `Fragment` from react and has no engine underneath (H3 falsified, verifiable from the file). Route (a), react-markdown through `@object-ui/fields` `MarkdownContent`, is off the claimed surface and would start rendering README images and tables. Judged right; the seat may still redirect to (a) as a separate card if it prefers a library parser.
12. **Pins cover triage's five — RIGHT.** (1) update dialog says update and names both versions; (2) major jump gives the notice and the link, with a minor-update CONTROL; (3) update draws no checkbox and sends `seedSampleData: false`; (4) CONTROL fresh install opens today's dialog, checkbox driving `seedSampleData: true`; (5) a README raw-HTML block neither rendered nor printed, with CONTROLS for code spans and fences, a bare less-than comparison, an angle-bracketed URL, and a no-HTML README. The objectui#12098 pin moves its selector to the update dialog's button and one expected sentence to `update.success`; the wait it measures is unchanged.
13. **Changeset body against the diff — RIGHT.** Every sentence in it is borne out: title, description and button; versions line; notice with a link only when notes exist; no checkbox and no sample-data request; the result and the expired-wait sentence; install path unchanged; the raw-HTML grammar with the code-span and fence control; eight keys named.

### ② Semver level

- `.changeset/12146-marketplace-update-dialog.md`: `@object-ui/app-shell: minor`, `@object-ui/i18n: minor`. The i18n accept set widens (① item 1), so the changeset is at least `minor`; both packages sit in the one fixed group of `.changeset/config.json`, so they move together regardless. No narrowing, no removal, no migration owed. **Level RIGHT.**
- **Clause-②: yes (widening)** — declared the same way on the claim `6115255402`, in the PR body, and in the changeset body, and the diff bears it out (the eight keys widen `TranslationKeys`). - **D1 — file outside the claim, `MarketplacePackagePage.servedTruth-12098.test.tsx`: ANSWERED, accepted.** The pin asserted the pre-card behaviour (the dialog's install button and the "deployed" sentence on the upgrade path) that the ruling changes on purpose; the edit is the selector and one expected key, the measured wait untouched. Not stopping was right: a pin of the old behaviour cannot survive the ruling. The seat records the surface addition.
- **D2 — H3 route (parser grammar instead of a renderer option): ANSWERED, accepted,** per ① item 11, with the condition-7 nit named in ① item 10. Not escalated; the seat may redirect to react-markdown as its own card.
- **D3 — bounded in-place fix, inline raw HTML dropped too: ANSWERED, accepted.** Same defect class, same file, same gate family, pinned and ablated; without it the ruling's "neither rendered nor printed" would hold for blocks and fail for the inline forms.
- **D4 — H2 cloud half NOT MEASURED: ANSWERED, immaterial.** The ruling hides the checkbox on either branch (① item 3). No access to objectstack-ai/cloud was needed for the action taken.

- **D6 — trailers (model-free pair, not the harness form): ANSWERED, accepted.** objectui AGENTS.md prescribes exactly that pair and says the harness reminder yields to it.

Out-of-scope findings (carrier: none):

- **O1 — the environment picker's pick is never read by `installPackage`:** pre-existing, documented in `installPackage`, inherited unchanged by the update mode; outside this card. Noted; the seat decides whether it earns a carrier.
- **O2 — no indented code blocks in `MarkdownText`,** so a four-space-indented raw tag is dropped rather than printed as code: pre-existing subset limit; the outcome is consistent with the card's direction to drop raw HTML. Noted; no action here.

`open_questions`: none declared, none found.
